title: Local Tumor Control in Liver Malignancies Treated with Interstitial Brachytherapy (iBT)
summary: HCC (hepatocellular carcinoma) and early-stage oligometastatic CRC (colorectal carcinoma), by extracting data from imaging follow-up and clinical databases will be be analyzed.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile ducts

interventions.name: After approval by the ethics committee, the data will be analyzed. If data are already available, they will be analyzed retrospectively.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
HCC (Hepatocellular carcinoma) and oligometastatic CRC(Colorectal carcinoma) with interstitial brachytherapy(iBT)
Exclusion criteria:
no treatment interstitial brachytherapy(iBT) 
no HCC
